data.name: Danna
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Danna means 'God's gift'. It is derived from the Greek word 'danos' which means 'gift'. This name is often used in the context of the Christian faith to signify the gift of life or the gift of faith.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's blessings and grace.
